newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN EXTEND LEAD WITH DRAW AT BOCHUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN EXTEND LEAD WITH DRAW AT BOCHUM.

text.p: Bayern Munich extended their Bundesliga lead to three points on Saturday after a Juergen Klinsmann goal gave them a 1-1 draw at Bochum.
Defender Torsten Kracht put Bochum ahead in the 55th minute and Klinsmann struck 10 minutes later.
Bayern then missed a string of chances to give themselves a five-point cushion over second-placed Borussia Dortmund, who lost 2-0 at Fortuna Duessldorf on Friday.
Third-placed Bayer Leverkusen and fourth-placed VfB Stuttgart both took advantage to close the gap with home wins.
Leverkusen beat Duisburg 1-0 while a last-minute goal from Germany striker Fredi Bobic gave Stuttgart a 1-0 victory over local rivals Karlsruhe.
